purpose: prospective held-out evaluation of three frozen models
count_policy: 30 per stage planned. Report actual attempted and eligible counts with reasons. Keep failed and stopped runs. Never rerun or replace from model results.

capture_policy.campaign: New campaign ID; separate new capture UUID and raw output directory for each stage
capture_policy.motion: Existing verified No.3 forward trajectory and unmodified B-to-A automatic return
capture_policy.servo_query: Existing 2 Hz sequential per-joint polling, 0.5 s response timeout, pause during return
capture_policy.accelerometer_mount: same bolt-and-nut ADXL #1 location and orientation

comparison.primary: LOGISTIC_BOLT vs LOGISTIC_MONSTER_GEL on identical accepted cycles; V4_PCA_Q is a fixed reference
comparison.better_rule: Observed overall normal FP no higher and every load TP no lower, with at least one strict improvement. Always show pair-specific FP and report any worsening pair separately. This is descriptive, not a significance or deployment criterion.
comparison.secondary: Paired AUROC/AP and type confusion for logistic models. Data and thresholds stay frozen.
comparison.scope: One new campaign; capture blocks are not independent dates. Training sets differ in mount, campaign and sample counts.
